caseNameFull: Ex parte: In the Matter of America Capo
attorneys: Mr. Frederic D. McKenney and Mr. F. H. Dexter for the petitioner. Mr. Malcolm Donald, Mr. Charles Hartsell and Mr. M. Rodriguez-Serra for the respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The rule to show cause hitherto allowed is discharged arid the petition for the allowance of the writ of mandamus is dismissed, and the prayer for the writ consequently denied. Ex parte Harding, 219 U. S. 363.
